description: Manual audit of 50 random insights from the full prompt-v2 population, read and labelled by hand on 2026-11-26 with the same label definitions as insights_v1_baseline.json. Population: every insight in site export c48a1cb (26 Nov) on an announcement dated before 25 Nov 2026 (14,971 rows); later rows were enriched live by prompt v3 after the 25 Nov pull and are excluded. Rows sorted by (ticker, timestamp, headline); random.seed(11), random.sample(rows, 50).

labels.unsupported: states a specific fact (name, number, place, date, or the company's business, sector, history, strategy or finances) not in the headline or company name
labels.outside: leans on outside knowledge or speculation (market conditions, sector trends, precedents) without a checkable invented fact
labels.clean: reasons only from the headline, or explains what this announcement type generally means
